name: outcome-loop
description: Run evidence-backed work until a frozen deterministic goal passes or a declared stop condition is reached.

interface.shortDescription: Finish work only when the measured goal passes.
interface.longDescription: Coordinates discovery, feasibility, building, independent review, and a frozen final check using hashed evidence and an append-only ledger.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the outcome loop to run this mission until its measured goal passes or a frozen stop condition is reached.
